extensionDescription.message: Sends Global Privacy Control with minimal overhead and explicit per-site exceptions.

unsupportedPageTitle.message: Site controls are unavailable on this page

unsupportedPageDescription.message: Chrome pages, extension pages, local files, and unsupported address types cannot be saved as site exceptions. The global network rule may still apply.

sendGpcCurrentSite.message: Send GPC for the current site

topicsDefaultDetail.message: Disabled at browser level without rewriting site responses

resourceDomainsTitle.message: Resource domains found on this page

resourceDomainsNote.message: A switch controls GPC when that domain is visited as a top-level site. It does not change current-page requests. Existing Resource Timing entries are read only on demand.

gpcDescription.message: Adds Sec-GPC: 1 to HTTP(S) requests and exposes a read-only JavaScript property on top-level pages.

topicsOptionDescription.message: Disables the browser Topics API directly without modifying a site's Permissions-Policy.

domainRecordsDescription.message: local records. Disabling a domain stops GPC for that domain and its subdomains when visited as a top-level site.

exceptionUnsupportedDetail.message: The global GPC setting still applies, but Chrome's domain-exception API does not support this address type.

coveredByParentDetail.message: This site is covered by the parent-domain exception $1. Enable the parent in the domain list first.

siteAccessMissing.message: Chrome has not granted site access here, so the extension configuration will not take effect.

topicsBlockedByExtension.message: Disabled at browser level by Let's GPC

topicsBlockedElsewhere.message: Disabled, possibly by Chrome, policy, or another extension

noCrossOriginResources.message: No visible cross-origin resource entries on this page.

sendGpcTopLevel.message: Send GPC when $1 is a top-level site

exceptionUnsupportedShort.message: Domain exceptions do not support this address type

settingsSaved.message: Settings saved. Open pages will use the new signal after their next reload.

confirmClear.message: Clear every domain record and site exception? Global settings will be preserved.

exceptionUpdated.message: Site exception updated. Reload related pages to apply it completely.

topicsCurrentlyBlocked.message: The Topics API is currently disabled at browser level.

topicsCurrentlyAvailable.message: The Topics API is currently available.

showingDomainResults.message: Showing the first $1 of $2 results. Keep typing to narrow the list.

badgeNoAccess.message: Let's GPC has no site access for $1

errorSupportTooLarge.message: GPC support resource is too large
